display.purpose: Page/section headings, modal titles, stat-card values.

body.purpose: Running text, nav labels, form labels, button labels.

label.purpose: Wordmarks, chip values, timestamps, compact field/section labels.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Selected chips, stat cards, lifted/active state.

motion.name: press-spring
motion.purpose: System-wide hover (lift/scale-up) and tap (scale-down) on nearly every button/chip/icon across guest and admin surfaces.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: CSS-level overshoot easing for tactile press/pop moments outside Motion's spring type.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Summary-bar booking CTA; claret fill, white text, spring hover/tap.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6e2a3a; color: #fff; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #551f2c; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Table Chip (selected)
components.description: Scaling table-row chip in its selected state - the signature guest-side selector.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; flex: 1 1 52px; min-width: 52px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid #e3dacb; background: #fff; padding: 8px 4px; text-align: center; transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, opacity 200ms; } .ds-chip-selected { border-color: #6e2a3a; background: #6e2a3a; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -4px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.14), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.08); } .ds-chip-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip-sub { font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Table Chip (default)
components.description: Scaling table-row chip in its unselected, available state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; flex: 1 1 52px; min-width: 52px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid #e3dacb; background: #fff; color: #1c1712; padding: 8px 4px; text-align: center; transition: background-color 200ms, border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, opacity 200ms; } .ds-chip-default:hover { border-color: #6e2a3a; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.06), 0 1px 1px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.04); } .ds-chip-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip-sub { font-size: 9px; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Hostess dashboard metric card - display-face value, muted mono-ish label, ambient elevated shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e3dacb; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -4px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.14), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.08); transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #756b5e; } .ds-card-value { margin-top: 12px; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 36px; color: #1c1712; }

components.name: Admin Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar/tab-bar nav link with lucide icon and active claret-tint state.
components.html: Дашборд
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #756b5e; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(227,218,203,0.5); color: #1c1712; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #f3e4e6; color: #6e2a3a; }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Centered dialog with backdrop, floating shadow, spring-motion close button.
components.html: Редактировать бронь
components.css: .ds-modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(28,23,18,0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; } .ds-modal-panel { width: 100%; max-width: 512px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid #e3dacb; background: #fff; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 20px 48px -12px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.24), 0 8px 20px -8px rgb(28 23 18 / 0.14); } .ds-modal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; color: #1c1712; } .ds-modal-close { display: flex; height: 36px; width: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #756b5e; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-modal-close:hover { background: #f7f3ec; color: #1c1712; }

narrative.overview:
TableFlow reads as a well-run dining room's paper reservation book brought online: warm paper and ink rather than a generic SaaS blue/purple, one confident wine-red (claret) accent standing in for the pen the maître d' would use, and gold held back entirely for the moment a booking succeeds. The guest-facing booking screen expresses this as a spatial decision rather than a form: the whole floor plan is visible first, and every choice beneath it (table, time) reads as one continuous row that scales to the viewport instead of wrapping, scrolling, or paginating - refusing the category-default date-picker-then-dropdown wizard. The hostess admin panel inherits the same paper/ink system unchanged and adds a unified lucide-react icon set with a consistent, restrained hover/press motion (a small lift or scale, spring-eased) across every interactive control, replacing what had been hand-rolled SVGs and glyph icons.

No real restaurant branding, logo, or photography exists or is invented anywhere in the system - typography and color alone carry the identity (confirmed in PRODUCT.md's Brand Commitments).
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper/ink base with a single wine-red accent; gold is rare and reserved for success states only
Fraunces (serif, display) paired with IBM Plex Sans (body) and IBM Plex Mono (operational/mono labels)
Scaling chip-rows, never wrapping or scrolling wizard/carousel patterns, are the signature guest-side interaction
Soft, ambient shadow vocabulary only - no hard offset/neobrutalist shadows anywhere in the build
Consistent spring-eased hover/press motion (lift on hover, scale-down on tap) on nearly every clickable element

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Claret is the only color carrying interactive/selection meaning (selected, primary action, active nav, link). No second "brand" hue is introduced anywhere in the build.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Gold never appears in a button, chip, nav item, or form control. It appears only in the success-celebration confetti/ring and as one of the decorative background-blob/particle hues - never as a functional or selection color.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Operational Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for tabular/operational content (chip values, timestamps, wordmarks, tight field labels) - narrative body copy always uses Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system is soft/diffuse and grows with elevation state (hover, selection, modal); none is a hard directional offset. A hard-offset "sticker" shadow would break this system and should not be introduced.

dos: Do keep claret as the only interactive/selection accent color; gold stays reserved for success-only moments.
Do use the spring whileHover/whileTap motion pattern (lift on hover, scale-down on tap) for new interactive controls, matching the existing stiffness/damping values.
Do use lucide-react for all icons; no hand-rolled SVG icons or unicode/emoji glyphs.
Do use the ambient soft/elevated/floating shadow scale; let shadow grow with elevation state rather than adding a new fixed shadow value.
Do let chip/row-based selectors scale to fill width before allowing wrap; wrap is a narrow-viewport fallback, not the default behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a hard-offset/neobrutalist shadow anywhere in this system; every shadow here is diffuse.
Don't add a second brand accent color alongside claret; extend with tints of claret or use the existing status colors for operational meaning instead.
Don't use gold for anything interactive (buttons, chips, active nav, links) - it signals "booking succeeded" and nothing else.

Don't invent decorative uppercase "kicker" text above headlines; the uppercase mono labels that exist are compact field/section labels tied directly to the control beneath them, not headline ornamentation - do not generalize them into a headline-kicker pattern.
Don't reintroduce a scrolling/paginated/wrapping-by-default row for a bounded option set (tables, times) on the guest surface; scale-to-fit is the established mechanic there.
